# typesense_stemming_dictionary (Resource)

A custom stemming dictionary that maps surface word forms to a root form. See the [Typesense API docs](https://typesense.org/docs/30.2/api/stemming.html). **Note:** Typesense does not currently expose an HTTP DELETE for stemming dictionaries; `terraform destroy` removes the resource from state and emits a warning, but the dictionary remains on the server until it is overwritten or the server data is wiped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "typesense_stemming_dictionary" "irregulars" {
  name = "irregulars_en"

  words {
    word = "people"
    root = "person"
  }

  words {
    word = "children"
    root = "child"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `words` (Block Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--words))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--words"></a>
### Nested Schema for `words`

Required:

- `root` (String) Root form the word maps to.
- `word` (String) Word form to be stemmed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import typesense_stemming_dictionary.irregulars irregulars_en
```
